S1.label: Dow pullback: in a 15-min HH+HL trend, buy when a new higher low is confirmed (mirror: buy the put when a new lower high is confirmed in a LH+LL trend)

S2.label: BOS continuation: in a 15-min HH+HL trend, the first 15-min close above the last swing high; stop below the last higher low

S3.label: CHoCH reversal: in a 15-min LH+LL trend, the first 15-min close above the last lower high; stop below the lowest low since it

S4.label: 1-2-3 reversal (Sperandeo / Ross): LL (1), LH (2), HL (3); buy when a wick takes out point 2; stop below point 3

S5.label: MSS then the first higher low (ICT): after S3's shift, buy when the next swing low above the shift's low is confirmed

S6.label: 60-min HH+HL trend + 5-min CHoCH back in its direction (multi-timeframe)

S7.label: Swing failure: a 15-min wick below the last swing low closes back above it

S8.label: Equilibrium (ICT discount): after a BOS leg, buy the first touch of the leg's 50%; stop below the leg low; target the leg high

S9.label: Shallow pullback (R135): after a BOS leg, buy the first touch of 25% back; stop beyond 50%; target the leg high

S10.label: BOS continuation, first hour only (entries to 10:15)

S11.label: Lower-high-after-lower-low: after a 15-min lower low breaks the trend, buy the put when the first lower high is confirmed (mirror: first higher low)

S12.label: S1 + R123's N1 network expected-value filter (2023 on)
